name: frametrace
description: Test tool: shows where a Windows game's frame time goes.
author: Swirl
title: Frame Trace
tagline: Frame timing for SwirlRun games (test tool).
long:
Runs a Windows game in a special SwirlRun build that measures every frame.
Type: frametrace /home/user/Games/HalfLife/hldemo.exe
Play for 30 seconds, close the game, then open /system/debug/frametrace.txt.
Remove it when done: spm remove frametrace
